cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 55% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.27%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -1.11%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: NRG is the standout at +4.83%
cards.body: Leaders: NRG +4.83%, UEC +2.46%, GEV +2.44%, VRT +2.44%, CCJ +2.43%. Laggards: FSLR -2.49%, EQNR -1.95%, FANG -1.65%, APA -1.64%.
